mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, merchant_name_normalized, avg_amount, cycle_days, detected_count, category_id, is_excluded, status, next_expected_date, confirmed_at, relapse_detected_at FROM tbl_fixed_expense_candidate WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_excluded = 0 AND ( (status = 'ACTIVE' AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) OR status = 'BUFFER' ) ORDER BY id

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.merchant_name_normalized, t.amount, t.tr_date, t.category_id, t.classification, t.cancel_yn, t.is_refund, t.is_excluded_from_summary FROM tbl_transaction t WHERE ORDER BY t.tr_date, t.id
